UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham on rejoining the EU:
All I'm going to do is look at what options might be available, so that people can see the pros and cons, but we'll set those out in due course. 
There's no rush to do that.

Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, Elbridge A. Colby:
NATO now needs to adapt to this new world. We definitely can keep working together. 
More than the possibility, there's the certainty that we can keep working together, but we need to adapt in doing so.

Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, Elbridge A. Colby:
We understand what's going on here in Europe. We're paying a lot of attention to it. 
We understand that Russia is rebuilding its military.

Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, Elbridge A. Colby:
We're going to allocate our military where it's most needed for Americans and where it's most needed from a military point of view, which, as the national security strategy sets out, is the Western Hemisphere and the Indo-Pacific, deterrence by denial along the first island chain.
That doesn't mean abandoning Europe. 
Rather, it means a different, rebalanced relationship with our allies.

با چنین کارنامه‌ای، فرمانده سنتکام را باید شایسته دریافت «مدال خسارت» دانست؛ فرمانده‌ای که ظاهراً در تحمیل خسارت به ناوگان پهپادی تحت فرماندهی خود، رکوردهای تازه‌ای ثبت می‌کند! ارتش آمریکا به‌جای نمایش برتری نظامی، اکنون باید پاسخ‌گوی خسارت‌های پی‌درپی به تجهیزات گران‌قیمت خود باشد؛ خسارت‌هایی که هر روز بر فهرست ناکامی‌های عملیاتی آن افزوده می‌شود.
